record.content: Signed STF-16-2025-01 p1 and map p2 prohibit camping, cooking, campfire building and fuel storage on National Forest lands at/below or within 100 feet above the 4,702-foot Cherry Lake high-water mark, and on its island. Effective January 27, 2025–December 31, 2026.
record.observer: Wayproof primary-source, map and source-feature review
